name: Chase Freedom Unlimited® Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months from account opening on purchases and balance transfers; see current Chase pricing and terms for exact rates.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

rewards.currency_label: Cash Back rewards tracked as Ultimate Rewards points

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all other purchases

categories.label: Dining at restaurants, including takeout and eligible delivery services

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash Back rewards do not expire as long as the account is open; there is no minimum to redeem for cash back.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $200 cash back bonus, awarded as 20,000 bonus points, after spending $500 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft, up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer's warranties of three years or less by one additional year, up to four years from the purchase date.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for eligible prepaid, non-refundable passenger fares when a covered situation cancels or interrupts a trip.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles when the card is used and the rental company's collision insurance is declined; coverage is secondary in the U.S.

benefits.title: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.description: You will not be held responsible for unauthorized charges made with your card or account information.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Complimentary 6 months of DashPass when activated by December 31, 2027, then automatic enrollment at the current monthly rate unless canceled.

benefits.title: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Order Discount
benefits.description: DashPass members get up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter through December 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Spend Instantly
benefits.description: After approval, cardmembers can receive instant access by adding the card to a digital wallet.

notes: Chase pricing terms state applicants may receive a Signature or Platinum card with different costs and/or benefits; no public credit score band was verified.
